# Negative results

Ideas that were tried and did not work, with the reason. They are as useful as the wins: they tell the next person where not to dig.

- 2026-11-24, invsqrt: [Exact SAT synthesis of the 128-row invsqrt table: each output bit needs at least 4 ANDs, and the method stops scaling at k = 3](entries/2026-11-24-loader-exact-synthesis-infeasible.md)
- 2026-11-24, invsqrt: [Where the invsqrt Toffoli mass sits: 91% unconditioned, and the conditioned gates are all measurement corrections firing half the time](entries/2026-11-24-invsqrt-firing-fractions.md)
- 2026-11-23, invsqrt: [Harness stage 1 on the 43-qubit line: no redundant Toffoli, and 10 never-firing gates cost nothing to keep](entries/2026-11-23-search-harness-stage1-dead-gates.md)
- 2026-11-22, invsqrt: [S2 on the v17 line: one qubit is 39 Toffolis, but the 43-qubit peak spans 27% of the steps in 287 segments](entries/2026-11-22-invsqrt-v17-width-profile.md)
- 2026-11-22, dqi: [v17 dqi generator read: the circuit we hold is its stack100 profile, and its newest profile is only 0.085% better](entries/2026-11-22-dqi-v17-generator-reading.md)
- 2026-11-22, dfthcsos: [v17 dfthcsos generator read: the public 8-bit table is a code-constrained, weight-refit table, and the field is tied at parts per million](entries/2026-11-22-dfthcsos-v17-generator-reading.md)
- 2026-11-19, dqi: [S6: the in-place Euclid history is moot; the frontier already scans at 11 Toffolis per position, the reciprocal scan needs 23](entries/2026-11-19-spike-s6-euclid-history.md)
- 2026-11-19, dqi: [DQI: the public 70x circuit conditions its gates the same way we do; the gap is unconditioned Toffolis (our 12,384 CSWAPs)](entries/2026-11-19-dqi-condition-statistics.md)
- 2026-11-17, infra: [S1: a static-count cost model is off by 4%; reduced-shot screening is exact to 1e-5 on invsqrt](entries/2026-11-17-spike-s1-cost-model.md)
- 2026-11-13, invsqrt: [invsqrt stage 2: the 62-qubit frontier uses our mathematics, and its advantage is lookup, normalisation, conditional execution and qubit count](entries/2026-11-13-invsqrt-stage2.md)
- 2026-11-13, invsqrt: [invsqrt one-pass study: the frontier has a Horner unwind after all, and none of four levers moves ratio 12.34](entries/2026-11-13-invsqrt-onepass.md)
- 2026-11-13, dqi: [The reciprocal-polynomial scan works classically (23 Toffolis per position) but no in-place Euclid history was found, so it was not built](entries/2026-11-13-dqi-psi.md)
- 2026-11-13, dfthcsos: [Our own table cannot reach 8 bits: every rounding schedule leaves about 0.025 of noise, and the gentle end of the schedule is not the problem](entries/2026-11-13-dfthcsos-eight-bit.md)
- 2026-11-12, dfthcsos: [Seven-bit angle words fail error_2 by 8.8x, and even a passing 7-bit table would save only about 3%](entries/2026-11-12-dfthcsos-low-brot.md)
- 2026-11-12, dfthcsos: [A loader whose cost is the table's GF(2) rank works, but our fit stalls at 0.029 and a rank budget cannot be imposed after rounding](entries/2026-11-12-dfthcsos-codesign.md)
